falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,200 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as the prior bottom structure would be violated rather than replicated; this would confirm continuation lower, not a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent extreme fear readings above the August 2024 panic peak would signal a different regime than the controlled capitulation pattern matched; the blowoff score of 40 would be proven insufficient for stabilization, indicating forced liquidation rather than exhaustion selling

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield rises above 4.75% while S&P 500 is below 4,400
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of rising rates into equity weakness would confirm a growth scare/liquidity crisis dynamic not present in the August 2024 bottom, where rates fell as equities stabilized; the macro divergence would invalidate the pattern replication thesis

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
